children: CEO Terry Mendez to participate in panel discussion on federal cannabis reform and what rescheduling means for Colorado operators
DENVER, Sept. 15, 2026
-- SHF Holdings, Inc., d/b/a
(the “Company” or “Safe Harbor”)
, a leading fintech platform serving the banking, lending, and financial services needs of the regulated cannabis and hemp industries, announced it will participate in
to address banking access, lending solutions and financial infrastructure for Colorado cannabis operators.

The conference takes place September 18 at the Westin Denver Downtown. Safe Harbor CEO Terry Mendez will join a panel discussion on federal cannabis rescheduling and what ongoing policy reform means for operators in the state. As registration sponsor, Safe Harbor will provide attendee check-in for the event, which is expected to draw more than 300 cannabis operators, investors, lenders and industry partners.

“Operators in mature cannabis markets like Colorado are under increasing pressure to manage capital more efficiently, strengthen their businesses and find financing partners that understand the industry,” said Mendez. “Safe Harbor is focused on providing the banking, capital and broader financial capabilities operators need to build more sustainable businesses.”
Conference Participation Details
Date: Friday, September 18 - 3:25pm-3:55pm MT
Panel Title: “The Rescheduling Rundown: What Medical Cannabis Reform Could Mean for Colorado”
Participants:
Terry Mendez, CEO, Safe Harbor Financial
Lauren Carboni, Partner, Foley Hoag
Nick Richards, Partner + Co-Chair of the cannabis practice group, Greenspoon Marder LLP
Tiffany Richardson, Cannabis Managing Partner, Crowe LLP
Moderated by Ryan Hunter, CRO, Speherex

Colorado is Safe Harbor's home market. The Company launched its first compliant cannabis banking program in the state in 2015 and has continued to build its platform to help cannabis businesses bank, borrow, operate and grow.

IgniteIt Market Spotlight: Colorado 2026 will bring together cannabis operators, investors and other industry decision-makers to discuss the financial and operational challenges facing the sector, including access to capital and long-term financial sustainability.
If interested in meeting Safe Harbor at the conference, please contact: marketing@shfinancial.org
About Safe Harbor:

Safe Harbor is a cannabis-exclusive financial platform delivering smarter banking, lending, payments and business services, and institutional solutions tailored to how the cannabis industry actually operates. As one of the original pioneers of compliant financial operations support and cannabis banking consulting in the U.S., Safe Harbor has assisted in the processing of more than $36 billion in cannabis-related depository funds across 41 states and territories. Through its proprietary technology, platform and network of regulated financial institution partners, Safe Harbor empowers cannabis operators to gain clarity, control and confidence in their financial operations. From daily banking and compliance infrastructure to long-term growth, Safe Harbor provides real solutions and personal support, built exclusively for cannabis. Safe Harbor is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services are provided by our partner financial institutions. For more information, visit shfinancial.org.
